summary: Recruitment advisors from UC Riverside (Aastha Chhikara), UC Santa Cruz (Beauti Deb), and UC Merced (Vaishnavi Kotiyal) walked counselors through the UC system's structure and application mechanics: 10 campuses total, only 9 offering undergraduate programs, over 300,000 students system-wide, a test-blind/test-free policy where SAT/ACT scores are never reviewed, a $95 per-campus application fee, and non-resident merit scholarships reaching up to $89,100 over 4 years at UC Riverside.
keyInsights: UC system: 10 campuses total, only 9 offer undergraduate programs; over 300,000 students system-wide.
UC is test-blind/test-free: ACT/SAT scores are not reviewed for admission or scholarships.
Application fee is $95 USD per campus for international/non-resident applicants; UC Riverside's non-resident merit scholarship reaches up to $89,100 over 4 years.
